title: GLG Achieves ISO 27001 Certification
summary: GLG announced it achieved ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, the widely used information-security management standard. The certification, obtained on December 2, 2025 and audited by A-LIGN, validates the security controls protecting client, expert, and employee data across GLG's core services.
whyItMatters: Security and compliance posture are increasingly central in vendor evaluation, especially for enterprise and regulated workflows. ISO 27001 is a meaningful trust signal for expert network buyers.
